THE BIG STORY
SpaceX: who earns?

lines.text: SpaceX's AI now sells the most. Starlink still makes the money.
lines.say: SpaceX's AI now sells the most. Starlink still makes the money.

lines.text: Tuesday evening, SpaceX reported a $4.4 billion profit, its first as a public company.
lines.say: Tuesday evening, SpaceX reported a four point four billion dollar profit, its first as a public company.

lines.text: Sales jumped 161% from a year earlier, to about $14.6 billion.
lines.say: Sales jumped a hundred sixty-one percent from a year earlier, to about fourteen point six billion dollars.

lines.text: Its AI unit, home of Grok, sold $7.6 billion, topping Starlink's $5.25 billion.
lines.say: Its AI unit, home of Grok, sold seven point six billion dollars, topping Starlink's five point two five billion.

lines.text: But in operating profit, AI made $431 million. Starlink made $2.37 billion.
lines.say: But in operating profit, AI made four hundred thirty-one million. Starlink made two point three seven billion.

lines.text: That's over five times more, from the smaller business.
lines.say: That's over five times more, from the smaller business.

lines.text: Starlink alone made about 85% of SpaceX's total operating profit.
lines.say: Starlink alone made about eighty-five percent of SpaceX's total operating profit.

lines.text: SpaceX says AI profit absorbed $1.2 billion of stock pay tied to its Cursor deal.
lines.say: SpaceX says AI profit absorbed one point two billion dollars of stock pay tied to its Cursor deal.

lines.text: So AI grabs headlines, but Starlink still does most of the earning.
lines.say: So AI grabs headlines, but Starlink still does most of the earning.

post.ig:
SpaceX's AI now sells the most. Starlink still makes the money.
SpaceX reported a $4.4B Q3 2026 profit, its first as a public company, on revenue of about $14.6B (+161%).
The AI unit brought in $7.6B in sales but $431M in operating profit; the Starlink unit made $2.37B on $5.25B.
That's about 85% of SpaceX's $2.8B operating profit. SpaceX says AI profit absorbed $1.2B of stock pay tied to its Cursor deal.
Sources: SpaceX Q3 2026 results (Oct 20, 2026), CNBC, Fortune, Forbes, Quartz.
News and education, not financial advice.
